messages.content: Use web search to find relevant datasets. Only include landing pages or DOIs. Do not invent links. Do not call time, date, timestamp, or clock tools.

Query: Can you find datasets about Social behaviour and attitudes, Media, Political behaviour and attitudes, Government, political systems and organisations, Elections, Economic policy, public expenditure and revenue, and Economic systems and development in Germany during the 2010s, matching this research need: German election campaign survey data on political attitudes, vote intentions and behavior, party evaluations, media use, social networks, economic perceptions, trust, issue positions, and detailed demographics around the 2013 federal and state elections.
Respond ONLY as JSON in this exact shape: {"items":[{"title":"...","url_or_doi":"...","justification":"..."}]}. Put any DOI, URL, landing page, or link in url_or_doi.
